cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your ladder application is approved at two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I have a five-minute rate? That's all I need.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One lift is authorized. You may add a compliment about my roses for the missing journey.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cash is approved at five pounds. I'll permit a two-pound reduction if you say we're still friends while handing it over.
